dataset_limitations: Tiny dataset sizes (17 + 20 images) - insufficient for production training
PPE labels auto-generated by YOLO26n (COCO person class) - not manually verified
Fire/smoke labels are whole-image bbox - not precise object localization
PPE helmet/vest/gloves classes deferred - no CC-licensed source data available
Class imbalance in fire_smoke val/test - small-n split artifact
day3_plan: Replace demo datasets with production sources (D-Fire + Hard Hat Workers v2)
Train YOLO26n (or yolo26s/m for better accuracy) on each dataset
Validate on val set; measure precision, recall, mAP50, mAP50-95
Test on unseen images and short videos
Save best weights to models/ppe_best.pt and models/fire_smoke_best.pt
Compare model sizes (n/s/m) on the Intel UHD laptop for speed/accuracy tradeoff
Training must be done on GPU machine (Colab or RTX 4060) - not on the UHD laptop
errors_encountered_during_day2: D-Fire dataset direct download failed - hosted on Kaggle (requires auth). Pivoted to Wikimedia Commons CC-licensed demo subset.
FiftyOne installation failed due to graphql-core version conflict with strawberry-graphql. Used imagehash library directly for duplicate detection instead.
PPE: 7 near-duplicate images detected via perceptual hashing (Wikimedia returned same stock photo under different search queries). Quarantined to datasets/invalid/ppe/duplicates/.
PPE: 6 images had no detectable person (small thumbnails or non-person search results). Skipped during auto-labeling.
Split script bug: residual files from previous split caused same file to appear in multiple splits. Fixed by fully clearing split folders before re-splitting.
